title: LinkedIn Company Employees Scraper (No Cookies)
description: Extract employees from LinkedIn company pages with filters for job titles, seniority, locations, and more. Supports short, full, and full + email search modes. No cookies or account required.

companies.title: Company LinkedIn URLs
companies.description: List of LinkedIn company URLs to extract employees from.

profileScraperMode.title: Profile Scraper Mode
profileScraperMode.description: Choose the mode for scraping employee profiles.

maxItems.title: Maximum employees to scrape
maxItems.description: Maximum number of employees to scrape total.

maxItemsPerCompany.title: Maximum employees per company
maxItemsPerCompany.description: Maximum number of employees to scrape per each company.

searchQuery.title: Search query (fuzzy search)
searchQuery.description: Query to search within company employees (e.g., 'Marketing Manager', 'Engineer').

jobTitles.title: Current Job Titles Filter
jobTitles.description: Filter employees by current job titles.

pastJobTitles.title: Past Job Titles Filter
pastJobTitles.description: Filter employees by past job titles.

seniorityLevelIds.title: Seniority Level Filter
seniorityLevelIds.description: Filter by seniority level IDs. 100=In Training, 110=Entry Level, 120=Senior, 130=Strategic, 200=Entry Level Manager, 210=Experienced Manager, 220=Director, 300=Vice President, 310=CXO, 320=Owner/Partner.

industryIds.title: Industry IDs Filter
industryIds.description: Filter employees by LinkedIn industry IDs.

yearsAtCurrentCompanyIds.title: Years at Current Company Filter
yearsAtCurrentCompanyIds.description: Filter by years at current company. 1=<1yr, 2=1-2yr, 3=3-5yr, 4=6-10yr, 5=10+yr.

startPage.title: Start Page
startPage.description: Page number to start scraping from.

takePages.title: Pages to scrape
takePages.description: Number of search pages to scrape (25 employees per page).

email.description: Employee email (if Full + email search mode)
